name: 04A - PostgreSQL Assistant - Natural Language to Safe SQL

parameters.content:
## Natural language to SQL

The workflow parser is defense in depth. The real boundary is a SELECT-only PostgreSQL login, curated schemas, row-level security, and statement timeout.

parameters.jsCode: const raw=$json.body ?? $json; const question=String(raw.question || '').trim(); if(question.length<3) throw new Error('question must contain at least 3 characters'); const allowedFormats=['json','text','chart','xlsx','rtf','html','pdf']; const format=String(raw.output_format || 'json').toLowerCase(); if(!allowedFormats.includes(format)) throw new Error('unsupported output_format'); return [{json:{test_mode:raw.test_mode===true,request_id:String(raw.request_id || ('sql-'+Date.now())),question,llm_provider:String(raw.llm_provider || $env.LLM_PROVIDER || 'gemini').toLowerCase(),output_format:format,guardrails:raw.guardrails || {allowed_schemas:['analytics'],allowed_tables:[],max_rows:500},mock_schema:raw.mock_schema || [],mock_plan:raw.mock_plan || null,mock_rows:raw.mock_rows || []}}];
const d=$input.first().json; if(!d.mock_plan) throw new Error('mock_plan is required in test mode'); return [{json:{...d,schema:d.mock_schema,plan:d.mock_plan}}];

parameters.query:
SELECT table_schema AS schema_name, table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb))
ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position
LIMIT 2000;

nodes.name: Load Allowed Schema
nodes.notes: Use the same SELECT-only assistant credential. Limit metadata to approved schemas.

parameters.jsCode: const q=$('Normalize SQL Question').first().json; const schema=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const system='Generate one read-only PostgreSQL SELECT query. Use only supplied tables and columns. Parameterize every user-derived value as $1, $2, etc. Never use DDL, DML, comments, locks, administrative functions, or multiple statements. Return only JSON.'; const user=JSON.stringify({question:q.question,requested_output:q.output_format,allowed_schema:schema,output_schema:{sql:'string',params:['value'],explanation:'string',output_format:q.output_format,chart:{type:'bar|line|pie',x:'column',y:'column',title:'string'}}}); return [{json:{...q,schema,llm_request:{system,user}}}];

parameters.jsCode: const base=$('Build SQL Generation Prompt').first().json; const r=$input.first().json.body ?? $input.first().json; let text=base.llm_provider==='openai'?r.choices?.[0]?.message?.content:base.llm_provider==='anthropic'?r.content?.[0]?.text:r.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.map(p=>p.text||'').join(''); if(!text) throw new Error('LLM response missing text'); text=String(text).replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,''); const plan=JSON.parse(text); plan.output_format=base.output_format; return [{json:{...base,plan}}];

nodes.name: Validate Read Only SQL
nodes.notes: Single-statement, read-only, allowlist, function, and row-limit checks. Still use a database-enforced read-only role.

nodes.name: Execute Approved Query
nodes.notes: This node must use the dedicated SELECT-only role with a statement timeout. Never attach an owner credential.
